steps.en: Build llama.cpp for your GPU, put a GGUF model on disk, install the Python deps
steps.zh: 按你的显卡编好 llama.cpp，备好 GGUF 模型，装 Python 依赖

steps.en: Start a sweep: your model, your llama-server, block sizes and the layer range to scan
steps.zh: 启动扫描：给出模型、llama-server、块大小和要扫的层范围

steps.en: For each candidate block, writes a temp GGUF with those layers physically duplicated
steps.zh: 对每个候选层块，写出一个把这几层物理复制一遍的临时 GGUF

steps.en: Serves it with llama-server, runs math/EQ/reasoning probes, scores vs baseline, deletes it
steps.zh: 用 llama-server 加载，跑数学/情商/推理探针，与基线比分，然后删掉

steps.en: Take the best-scoring block and spell it out as an explicit layer execution path
steps.zh: 挑出得分最好的层块，写成一条显式的层执行路径

steps.en: Writes a new GGUF whose forward pass runs that block twice, ready for llama-server
steps.zh: 写出新的 GGUF，前向时把这块层跑两遍，可直接给 llama-server 用

value.en: You find which layer block, run twice, shifts your local model's reasoning — and get a GGUF to test it, with no training
value.zh: 不训练就找出哪几层“多想一遍”能改变你本地模型的推理表现，并拿到可直接测的 GGUF

sources: https://github.com/alainnothere/llm-circuit-finder#quick-start (pip install gguf requests tqdm; python sweep.py --model /path/to/model.gguf --llama-server ...; python layer_path.py model.gguf improved.gguf -p "0..14,12,13,14,15..39" -v)
https://github.com/alainnothere/llm-circuit-finder#how-the-sweep-works (GGUF surgery per config, llama-server, three probe suites, compare to baseline, delete modified GGUF; tmpfs /dev/shm)
